The non-eight-node helper stores the first three table-selected nodes in four-slot candidate records. It only writes a nonzero fourth candidate node when width equals four.
Its membership loop is controlled by the selected face width, while each candidate record occupies only four slots.
The fourth output slot is explicitly filled only for width four or, by repeating the first node, width three. The width-six path needs assembly/runtime verification before interpreting its output.
